subject: duplicate labels detected for some individuals; using generic labelsnon-polymorphic marker(s) delete

messages.author: f32f82376f8a1160
messages.subject: duplicate labels detected for some individuals; using generic labelsnon-polymorphic marker(s) delete
parts:
Hi, 

I tried using poppr but I did not understand what is wrong with my genalex table:
I I use the command : cory <- read.genalex("cory.csv", ploidy = 1, geo = FALSE, region = FALSE, sep = ",", recode = FALSE)
And R studio says: duplicate labels detected for some individuals; using generic labelsnon-polymorphic marker(s) deleted

i have 169 isolates, 191 loci and 9 populations. 
In the column 1 i have the ID of isolates, and in the column 2 i have the ID of populations. 

my  R version 3.5.1 (2018-07-02)
and other attached packages:
 [1] treemap_2.4-2  dplyr_0.7.8    magrittr_1.5   mmod_1.3.3     ggplot2_3.1.0  ape_5.2       
 [7] poppr_2.8.1    adegenet_2.1.1 ade4_1.7-13    WriteXLS_4.0.0 readr_1.2.1 

best, 

Ana

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] duplicate labels detected for some individuals; using generic labelsnon-polymorphic marker(s) delete
parts:
Hi Ana,

You get the warning "duplicate labels" because you have the ID "108" at rows 132 and 162 of your data. 
You get the non-polymorphic markers deleted because loc42 is not polymorphic.

Hope that helps,

Zhian
